St. Louis CITY SC prepares to face LA Galaxy at Energizer Park on Oct. 11
St. Louis CITY SC will face LA Galaxy at Energizer Park on October 11 following their historic unbeaten run. The match features special Hispanic Heritage Night activities for fans and continues an undefeated series between both teams.
St. Louis CITY SC will host LA Galaxy at Energizer Park on Sunday, October 11, with kickoff scheduled for 6:00 p.m. CT and broadcast available on Apple TV.
The match follows St. Louis CITY SC's recent 3-0 victory over Red Bull New York, which extended the club’s unbeaten streak to 19 consecutive matches across all competitions and marked their first win against the New York side. Rafael Navarro scored early in the fifth minute, with Simon Becher and Tomáš Ostrák adding goals in the second half.
Fans attending Sunday's game can participate in Hispanic Heritage Night activities, including live music from Tatiana Rose, games, food vendors on Lou Fusz Plaza, festival entertainment, and merchandise opportunities such as the Somos CITY Scarf during a Block Party. The first 10,000 fans through the gates will receive a Somos CITY Beanie courtesy of American Family Insurance.
St. Louis CITY SC has achieved a record-setting run since May 9 with a current stretch of 17 straight unbeaten games in Major League Soccer play and an overall tally of 19 across all competitions. During this period, they have moved from fourteenth to second place in the Western Conference standings with a total of 47 points and hold a record of twelve wins and five draws without defeat.
Simon Becher has become one of Major League Soccer’s top scorers since league play resumed after the World Cup break by scoring eight goals across twelve regular-season appearances; his most recent goal came as a substitute against Red Bull New York, marking his third goal in three matches across all competitions.
Since joining Major League Soccer in 2023, St. Louis CITY SC remains unbeaten against LA Galaxy with three wins and four draws over seven meetings—a series that has produced twenty-eight goals total (averaging four per match). Head coach Yoann Damet previously served as an assistant coach for LA Galaxy under Greg Vanney, while several players have connections between both clubs including forward João Klauss who joined LA ahead of this season.
